items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: One was to play the Leonard Bernstein mass and that was because of Chuck Israels, another bass player, was always recommending me for stuff.

ctx.x: Well I pretty much always had that — there have been instances where I was pretty sure I wasn't going to do so well and I would turn the gig down with that. Sorry that I did now. One was to play the Leonard Bernstein mass and that was because of Chuck Israels, another bass player, was always recommending me for stuff. And so it is what it is. I knew that, you know it was just kismet, you know? And the phone rings and you know I’ve had so many offers. You know, say really good paying, good gig offers that I had to…
You know Steve Gilmore said that he thinks he missed some work because people thought oh well he plays with Phil Woods. He’s not going to be able to do anything else.
